content: It will be observed that the "Gopis" here personify the five senses. Lassen says, "_Manifestum est puellis istis nil aliud significar quam res sensiles_."
The text here is not closely followed.
My proud one! do not indulge in scorn.
Much here also is necessarily paraphrased.

This complete anticipation (_salajjâ lajjâpi_) of the line-- "Upon whose brow shame is ashamed to sit" --occurs at the close of the Sarga, part of which is here perforce omitted, along with the whole of the last one.
